visualReview.notes: Inspected 54 current frames:12 portable,12 shared-material/flat-map and30 Earth-rig/native-terrain/tier views. The50m stone body retains its tall narrow central portal, two lower side tunnels, broad solid piers, low deck crown, arch-ring stones and restored slab deck.33 paired lion posts are present near; original stylized sculptures include seated bodies, haunches/forelegs/paws, muzzle/jaw, ears, mane tufts and tails, with finer brows/toes in the master. They are not claimed as replicas of66 individual historic carvings. Distance levels aggregate the sculpture/post details while all three arch tunnels remain open. The continuous non-convex wall shell replaces overlapping arch-slice caps that caused visible streaks. Hidden stone backs were removed; minor High-mode shadow faceting remains on shallow raised courses, with no missing wall panels. Low-contrast shared raw limestone serves masonry/sculptures and shared granite serves paving:two existing256px graphs in three material groups,no private or embedded images. Named 永通桥 and Tonghui canal centerlines establish the signed north/south crossing; the separate western modern bridge remains intact in the actual production road-suppression test. The generalized149m tagged line includes approaches;bounded paved tails connect atX±65m and are not a surveyed original landscape. All30 Earth views use the unmodified ordinary viewer native heightfield plus a schematic water rectangle. Four focused tests prove exact source/tier bytes, all three physical tunnel apertures,66 near lion silhouettes,native endpoint ground+0.25m and retained modern crossing/remaining road fragments. Precise bridge/bank grades,original arch-bed/water clearances,stone/carving patterns and physical-device timing remain approximate or unmeasured.

siteIntegrationReview.source: Standard viewer PMTiles and one ordinary global Terrarium tile;no bespoke survey/terrain source.
siteIntegrationReview.notes: The unmodified65x65/2.5m field oversamples coarse urban DEM and cannot resolve all three original arch beds or quay walls. The21m reference datum is approximate. Paved approach tails follow the named mapped approach axis and terminate at native ground+0.25m. Original body/approach grades are reconstructed. Schematic rectangular water is a separate review entity,not exact native bank geometry or a measured river surface.

runtimeLodReview.notes: Four authored browser tiers;at most three draws;two shared texture graphs;no embedded/private images;separate position/normal streams. Detailed source remains separate. No physical-device timing claim.
